outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E-stained micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel C contains a box plot of total polyp number (distribution already shown, exempt) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse by diameter and genotype. The bar chart shows only aggregated bar heights across n=8–18 mice per genotype without overlaid individual data points.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a western blot pulldown image and a bar graph quantifying relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G includes immunoblots/zymography and a bar graph of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers, but no individual data points are shown on the bars.
